detail.longDescription: A session ID is not a credential. Grafana's MCP server only checked that Mcp-Session-Id was well formed, so anyone who could reach it could mint one, call tools/call and borrow its Grafana service-account token. A spoofable X-Grafana-URL header also made it an SSRF proxy (CVE-2026-19516, CVSS 9.1). v1.1.0 adds bearer-token auth, but it is optional. Turn it on. https://www. pillar.security/blog/valid-but -never-issued-session-spoofing-and-ssrf-in-grafana-mcp # Cybersecurity # MCP # AIAgents
